journey.name: choose lsp from transfer to spending
journey.description:
Verifies the way to a channel that is left after Blocktank channel purchases were removed (synonymdev/bitkit-android#1669). Transfer To Spending opens the "Manual setup required" sheet, whose "Continue" button (testTag "ChannelsUnavailableSheetContinue") opens the "Choose a Lightning provider" screen. That screen lists third-party providers (testTag "ChooseLspProvider"), and each row opens the provider's own channel order page in the browser. Its footer has "Manual Setup" (testTag "ChooseLspManual"), which opens the manual channel setup with an empty node, and "QR Code" (testTag "ChooseLspScan"), which opens the scanner for the provider's LNURL channel or node QR. No step creates a Blocktank order. The design (Figma, Bitkit - Final Review v63 › Third-party LSP › Choose LSP) shows the provider page embedded in the app; this build opens it in the browser instead.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet with a positive on-chain Savings balance, so the Savings wallet shows "Transfer To Spending". A channel is not needed. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the Savings balance card (testTag "ActivitySavings"), then "Transfer To Spending" (testTag "TransferToSpending")

Verify the sheet (testTag "ChannelsUnavailableSheet") shows the title "MANUAL SETUP REQUIRED" (testTag "ChannelsUnavailableSheetTitle"), then tap "Continue" (testTag "ChannelsUnavailableSheetContinue") and verify the sheet closes

Verify the screen titled "Spending Balance" shows "CHOOSE A LIGHTNING PROVIDER", the text "Order a channel from a Lightning Service Provider (LSP). Below are some options. Bitkit does not run, endorse, or support these." and four provider rows (testTag "ChooseLspProvider"): "LNBIG", "ZEUS Olympus", "Megalithic" and "Amboss Magma"

Verify the explanation "When they give you a QR to connect or claim the Lightning channel, tap below to scan or paste the QR." and the buttons "Manual Setup" (testTag "ChooseLspManual") and "QR Code" (testTag "ChooseLspScan") are visible
Tap "Megalithic" and verify the browser opens https://megalithic.me/get_a_channel, then return to Bitkit and verify the provider screen is still shown
Tap "QR Code" (testTag "ChooseLspScan") and verify the scanner sheet opens, then close it
Tap "Manual Setup" (testTag "ChooseLspManual") and verify the manual connection screen shows empty node id (testTag "NodeIdInput"), host (testTag "HostInput") and port (testTag "PortInput") fields
